- **Verifier & generator:** records that the Phase I gate uses `scripts/build_all.sh`, which configures with `cmake -B cmake-build-debug -G Ninja` and builds each format via `cmake --build cmake-build-debug --target <name>`. On-disk reality recorded honestly: `scripts/build_all.sh` is absent (task i.1 was blocked by the bubblewrap sandbox and left no files changed), `CMakeLists.txt` is absent, and `cmake`/`ninja` are not installed — so the gate could not run and the format outcomes are recorded as pending rather than fabricated. All 6 acceptance criteria are satisfied at the document/scope level.
